requirements.text: The system shall enforce a maximum borrowing limit of 5 books per member to maintain safety and accountability.
The system shall automatically track and notify members of overdue books within 24 hours via a single notification mechanism.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of failure.
The system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The system shall log all transactions for audit purposes.
The system shall allow librarians to add or remove books with a latency of less than 3 seconds per operation.
The system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The system shall allow a maximum of 8 simultaneous borrow operations with strict monitoring.
The system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption through efficient operations.
The library management system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding fairness in library services.
The library management system shall implement data encryption for all member personal information stored.
